scope: Only gold.answer rewritten into concise source-grounded Russian explanations. No test file read; no rows added or removed; no model compute. Isolates the answer-label format and explanatory content intervention; it is not merely whitespace normalization.

manual_semantic_review.basis: Source-handbook F01-F30 and НЕОПИСАННЫЕ УСЛОВИЯ; each original train/validation question and evidence.
manual_semantic_review.discount_threshold: At least 5 on one ordinary session, Mon-Fri, 20%; no premiere/pass discount.
manual_semantic_review.refund_boundaries: Ordinary >=6h full; 2h<=t<6h half; t<2h zero. Premiere >=24h full; t<24h zero.
manual_semantic_review.passes: Personal, non-transferable, one visit per pass per day, no premieres; Искра Mon-Thu/3 visits/24 EUR/21 inclusive days; Туман any day/5 visits/44 EUR/40 inclusive days.
manual_semantic_review.unknown: Absence of information is distinguished from a negative service-availability fact. No seat availability invented.
manual_semantic_review.math_in_answers: Explicit arithmetic for derived prices/refunds; unchanged machine-readable gold.data remains authoritative.

source_integrity_note: Original files were read only; all writes targeted clean-data-draft. Input SHA256 values above identify exact originals; no test file was opened.
